title: コンピュータアーキテクチャ設計
subtitle: Computer Architecture and Design
teachers:
TAMURA Osamu
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)	learn the processor organization through circuit design.
(2)	learn processor components.
(3)	learn to design the basic processor.
(4)	learn to design advanced processors with additional instructions.
advice:
This is an advanced computer architecture course. The knowledge learned in this subject is the foundation for AI and IoT technologies. We will cover the following materials:

1. Design method of logic circuits
2. Design of processor components
3. Design of basic processor
4. Design of advanced processors
books: コンピュータアーキテクチャ[コロナ社]
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of radix conversion, basic knowledge of logic circuit operations such as adder, selector, and register are required. Students should also understand data flow and control flow in the processor and basic usage of the “Logisim” logic simulator.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the circuit design procedures that are used in logic circuit simulators.
Be able to design small processor components from functional specifications.
Be able to conduct basic processor design from functional specifications.
Be able to add instructions to the basic processor.
Be able to verify a processor function using an assembler.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1)	Be able to fully acquire circuit design techniques using a logic simulator.
(2)	Be able to fully explain a basic computer configuration.
(3)	Be able to design basic processors based on specifications.
(4)	Be able to expand advanced processors based on specifications.
(5)	Be able to report these achievements accurately.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1)	Be able to design processor components based on specifications.
(2)	Be able to explain the operation of a basic processor circuit.
(3)	Be able to verify the operation of a basic processor circuit.

              Students will:
(1)	learn the processor organization through circuit design.
(2)	learn processor components.
(3)	learn to design the basic processor.
(4)	learn to design advanced processors with additional instructions.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is an advanced computer architecture course. The knowledge learned in this subject is the foundation for AI and IoT technologies. We will cover the following materials:

1. Design method of logic circuits
2. Design of processor components
3. Design of basic processor
4. Design of advanced processors

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

               コンピュータアーキテクチャ[コロナ社]

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              Knowledge of radix conversion, basic knowledge of logic circuit operations such as adder, selector, and register are required. Students should also understand data flow and control flow in the processor and basic usage of the “Logisim” logic simulator.
